//: Self-contained on purpose. This file is reached through a pnpm symlink (packages/*/node_modules/@anis/config), and a relative `extends` out of the package resolves against the symlink path rather than the real one — tsc copes, Vite's oxc transform does not, and the failure is 'tsconfig not found' in node_modules. Keeping every option here means the only `extends` that ever crosses a package boundary is this file itself, which resolvers handle via normal package resolution.
